snippet.title: miuma trailer
snippet.description:
steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1877480/Miuma/
patreon: https://www.patreon.com/natoptishi
glad to see you on our youtube channel. we're a team of indie-game developers. now we’re aiming at the game called miuma. it’s a cozy game about a tiny bakery sited in the middle of nowhere and a significant feat of its new owner, kevin. we’re going to create something more than a simple bakery simulator. miuma will have old town’s calmness and wild forest’s freedom. explore a huge world of islands, meet people around you, and experience together with kevin! here on youtube, we’ll post these adorable speedpaints with different game elements we’re creating. 
thanks for reading! hope you will join us on steam and patreon! your support helps us to maintain development and share our games with the world!
follow us on the instagram: https://www.instagram.com/natoptishi/
business gmail natoptishi.corp@gmail.com
